evidence.title: Raivcoo – Daily Video Editing & Motion Graphics Inspiration

name: Raivcoo
summary: Gallery of motion graphics and video editing references from creators worldwide, with filters and bookmark collections.
description: A curated space to browse thousands of video edits and motion graphics references from creators worldwide. Filter by style, category, color, software and aspect ratio, save favourites into folders and share collections publicly; members can upload their own work. The site also sells After Effects plugins for editors and motion designers.
contains: thousands of motion graphics and video edit references
filters: style, category, color, software, aspect ratio
bookmark folders that can be shared publicly
After Effects plugins from free to $10
